text:
Evelyn: dropping a quick thread on the compact compare row behavior after the latest perf-badge change. see Figma: https://redwood.mock/fig/compact-row-v3. main trade: show each active filter as its own chip vs compress into a single summary pill. also badge surface copy debate: 'Median' vs 'Typical' + units.
Marco: My vote is separate chips for scanability. summary pill hides which filters are set. but we should support a very dense mode where chips collapse into '+N' after 4.
Sam: +1. If we collapse, the +N must be keyboard-focusable and announce the list when opened. e.g., clicking +N -> panel lists filters with checkboxes.
Jules: Accessibility notes: a11y-bot suggests when the +N opens we should update a live region: 'Filters expanded: quantized, short-context, safety-filter'. Also ensure the +N has an aria-expanded state.
a11y-bot: Recommendation: use role="button" with aria-haspopup="listbox" on the +N trigger. When opened, set aria-expanded="true" and populate an offscreen `div` with aria-live="polite" containing the visible items. Focus should move to the first item in the list. On close, return focus to the +N trigger and announce 'Filters collapsed'.
Evelyn: Good. For badge copy: current surface reads 'p50 120ms' which is terse. Proposal: surface '120 ms' and append a microtag 'typ.' or an icon. tooltip shows full: 'p50: 120 ms; p95: 420 ms; n=1,240'.
Marco: I like '120 ms' as primary. 'Median' vs 'Typical' — 'Typical' reads friendlier in product copy. keep p50/p95 in the tooltip.
Sam: Performance badge contrast: small text on colored capsule fails AA. either increase font-size (not ideal) or darken color and add icon to avoid color-only signal.
Jules: Also, badges should have clear aria-labels: e.g., aria-label="Typical latency 120 milliseconds, median over 1,240 requests" so screenreaders don't rely on visual truncation.
ProductOps: Microcopy suggestion for pinning a version: current modal says 'Confirm pin'. better: 'Pin model version for this project' and an explanator 'If this version is unavailable we will fall back to a compatible variant.' keep fallback copy short.
Evelyn: UX detail: pinned rows should show a small pin icon and a tooltip 'Pinned for project'. make the icon keyboard reachable and togglable.
Marco: Edge case: what if user pins a version on Dedicated and then the model gets updated upstream. need to clarify in modal that pinning pins the version id, not the tag. (add `Version ID: v12.3` in the modal).
Sam: I'll prototype the +N interaction with focus trap and live region copy. will also produce contrast variants (3 color shades + icon option).
Jules: I'll add acceptance criteria for screenreader announcements and keyboard flows to the ticket. include tests: 1) tab to +N, Enter opens list and focus lands on first item, 2) aria-live announces items, 3) Close returns focus and announces 'Filters collapsed'.
Evelyn: timeline: try to get Figma updates + prototype link by tomorrow morning so eng can review in sprint planning.
ProductOps: noted. I'll create the ticket with acceptance criteria and link prototypes.
Evelyn: thanks team 44d
